raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to extract the relevant information from the initial search results that clearly identified Mauro Scocco as the composer of "Till dom ensamma" and provided his birth date (11 September 1962) from Wikipedia. Instead of confirming and reporting this information directly, WebSurfer continued to perform redundant searches without effectively corroborating the data or verifying the composer attribution from credible sources. This led to unnecessary repetition and inefficiency in solving the problem.
